market_question: SpaceX IPO closing market cap above $1.4T?
reasoning: SpaceX's latest private valuation is ~$350B; reaching $1.4T on its first trading day would require a >4x IPO pop, unprecedented for a company of this size. Elon Musk has indicated SpaceX will likely stay private until Mars missions are underway, making an IPO before 2028 improbable. Even a successful IPO would be far below this market cap, so YES is extremely unlikely.
evidence_points: SpaceX was valued at roughly $350 billion in late 2024 private funding rounds (Reuters); $1.4T would be 4x that, far beyond typical IPO pops.
Musk has repeatedly said he prefers SpaceX private to avoid short-term investor pressure, postponing any IPO until after regular Mars flights (CNBC interview, 2023).
Even if an IPO occurred, the most optimistic pre-IPO valuation would be $500-600B, and a first-day surge to $1.4T has no precedent in history.
sources_consulted: CNBC: Elon Musk comments on SpaceX IPO 2023
